objective: Concepts for the next animal set, the rhinos (decision 0054): the Rhino, the Lava Rhino and a new Crystal Rhino variant, in a rounder build, each with a presentation card. Concept only: nothing is uploaded or wired into the game until SHANNON approves.
acceptance_criteria: The three rhinos read as one family and sit with the families before
Each builds, bakes and exports through the normal build with the usual rig pieces and joints
StationConfig, StationAssets and the manifest are untouched until SHANNON approves
verification: Blender 5.2 on 2026-11-15: full build (bake and export) of creature_rhino (2196 tris), creature_rhino_lava (2424) and creature_rhino_crystal (2204) passed with the usual pieces and the glow pieces; the cards were inspected. At their final scales they measure about 6.7 tall x 13.9 long, 10.1 x 18.5 and 10.5 x 16.0 studs (worked out from the built sizes, not rebuilt). The manifest was restored after the test builds, so the game is unchanged. Lune 687/687. Not done: the upload, the StationConfig variant, the clips on the new shapes; the other faceted families were not rebuilt after facet.py gained its two helpers (nothing they use changed).
notes: Checkpoint for SHANNON: approve the three looks, the Crystal Rhino (legendary, twist defence) and the rounder build. On approval the next step is the build for upload, the upload workflow, the StationConfig variant and a look at the clips, as for the other families. Still open from STATION-036: the lions in the game carry the vertex-colour fault and need a rebuild and a new upload.
